model_output: It seems that you have provided a list of topics related to mutuality, pot-to-pot communication, service measures, and scenarios. These topics relate to secure communication and authentication in a container network environment. Mutuality refers to the concept of establishing a secure communication channel between two parties, while pot-to-pot communication refers to the ability of pots to communicate with each other. Service measures are used to implement these concepts, and scenarios are used to describe and evaluate the implementation. The default situation in communities is that every pot can communicate with every other pot, but this communication is unencrypted. In a common scenario, an ingress is used to accept traffic from the outside and forward it into the cluster. If the ingress is public-facing, it is likely to be protected by GPS.
